svg.title: Who is by the fire: a life in six pixel frames
svg.desc: Six framed pixel-art panels, left to right: hippie parents (a camper van with a flower), a childhood on a farm (barn and a pecking chicken), the farm becomes a winery (vines and a barrel), wine engineer (a grape wearing a graduation cap, with a diploma), wine crisis into public administration (desk, file stacks, a stamp), and today: vibecoder (Pix with a laptop by a small campfire at night).
